O1_Eg_is_the_unique_nonmixing_splitter.statement: three distinct masses without axis mixing <=> a nonzero E_g (diagonal-traceless) field; T2g only mixes axes, A1g only shifts the trace

O2_Eg_lives_on_second_shell.statement: no E_g in the first (mass-step) shell; the orthorhombic field's minimal home is the SECOND (cube-axis) shell — F49's shell

O3_stabilizer_D2h_S3_broken.statement: generic E_g angle leaves D_2h with NO residual axis permutation: S_3 completely broken, so no symmetry can generate the democratic stiffness kappa (F84's kappa-removal as a stabilizer theorem); delta=0 keeps a swap -> [2,1] and a protected kappa

O4_Eg_equals_Z3_parametrization.statement: diag of the E_g doublet at angle delta is exactly sqrt(2/3) cos(delta - 2pi a/3): F76-C6's Z3 form IS an A1g background + E_g condensate; F76's fitted phase is the condensate angle

O5_landau_phase_diagram.statement: orthorhombic (three distinct masses) wins iff C>0 and |B|<2C, with cos3delta* = -B/(2C); the quartic theory can NEVER do it (sextic invariant required); b=0 gives the maximal point delta*=30deg

O5b_T1u_quartic_cannot_orthorhombify.statement: a vector (T1u) condensate at quartic order points along (111) or (100) only — it cannot supply a generic three-distinct-axis direction; the E_g channel is structurally required

O6_dispersion_Oh_symmetric_no_explicit_E.statement: the vacuum dispersion (incl. the F30 anisotropy) is exactly O_h-symmetric: it carries zero E_g component, so the orthorhombic field CANNOT be inherited from the dispersion — it must be spontaneous (O5) or external

O7_data_condensate_angle.statement: the lepton condensate angle is GENERIC (orthorhombic confirmed, far from tetragonal), amplitude ratio = sqrt2 (the 45deg equipartition), and the one number the Landau theory leaves free is cos(3 delta) = -B/(2C) — F76's phase, now a ratio of two Landau coefficients
